R124 - Players 3.4 portrait / head reassignment inputs (prompt research-20260926-after-receipt3, package 3). Read-only.
Gen7 (the R53 loose roots: X360 NHL 09 -> Legacy, PS3 NHL 15 / Legacy): directory listings of `rendering/player` (head meshes
`player_<id>` / `head_<id>`, head texture libraries `texlib_<id>`) and `fe/ion/artassets/playerheads/*/p<id>.big` (portraits) joined to the
anchor's `exhibitionplayerbiotable` (artid = lOnr, headid = pPaD, hasportrait). Per title:
  * declared bit width of artid / headid vs the largest shipped file id (can every shipped target be stored?);
  * head meshes with / without a same-id texture library, split by use (roster-referenced or not) and by pool floor (Studio's data-driven rule:
    60 000 if any roster head id reaches it, else 10 000) - whether a target head carries its own textures or relies on something else;
  * sharing: head ids and portrait ids referenced by more than one bio row (pool / non-pool), and rows whose head id equals another
    row's portrait id;
  * coverage of the DB head tables `stockplayerheads` / `stockplayerhelmetplacement` (keyed by headid) over mesh files and roster ids;
  * every other column in the database whose name mentions art / head / hair / portrait / face, with how many of its values are bio
    artid or headid values (candidate consumers a reassignment must consider; overlap is not proof of a join).
PS4 (anchors + genuine NHL 20): the same column scan plus headid vs headtexture per row (the head binding is the vault attribute of 2026-09-20 handoff 08).
Usage: python r124_head_portrait_reassignment_inputs.py <r53.json> <out.json>
